3.answer: First, you need to have a rough idea of what you want to get tattooed. Based on your preferences, choose a tattoo artist whose style you like best and contact them. See the booking instructions. Before getting tattooed, read the tattooing instructions and customer etiquette. Before deciding on a tattoo, it is always a good idea to consult with the tattoo artist. Discussing your ideas, wishes and expectations will enable better understanding and cooperation between you and the tattoo artist and allow you to create a tattoo that is unique. On the day of your appointment, you will fill out a tattoo consent form, confirm the design, determine the exact location and size of the tattoo, and print the stencil. The tattoo artist will prepare your skin (shave, disinfect) and apply the stencil. Once you have confirmed that everything is as you want it, the tattooing process will begin. Once the tattoo is complete, a protective film is applied over it. Then, carefully follow the aftercare instructions. In rare cases, a tattoo may need to be touched up. If you need a touch-up, contact your tattoo artist and make an appointment for a free correction.
3.question: How does tattooing work?

qa.answer: Healing is an organic bodily process, which is why tattoo corrections are sometimes necessary. The body perceives pigment as a foreign substance and attempts to digest it through the lymphatic system during the healing process. Sometimes the body manages to break down the pigment particles and flush them out of the body. Especially with delicate, small tattoos or large areas of colour, it often happens that the tattoo is paler in certain areas than in others. If you have followed the aftercare instructions, you are entitled to one free repair within the first 6 months after tattooing. Do not delay and contact your tattoo artist to make your tattoo flawless.
